name: agent-identity-governance
description: Nine skills that treat AI agents, service principals, workload identities, API keys and MCP connectors as identities with an inventory, owners, recertification, expiry and an off switch: one inventory across Entra ID, AWS IAM, GitHub and a hand-kept register; a review of Entra agent identities; quarterly recertification sheets per owner; an expiry radar for secrets, certificates, keys and tokens; a register check for MCP servers and connectors; a timeline of one agent's actions from audit exports; a kill switch runbook with a coverage check; a leaked credential response pack with hashed evidence; and a hash chain that makes an agent audit log tamper-evident and shows actions it never recorded. Standard-library scripts over saved exports, no network.
